review_boundary: Existing source breakdown and dated 0.8.0 candidate tests, no re-research or new mechanism.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: No system-side objective or instrumental tactic selection is established. Human criminal intent cannot supply those missing facts.
Reported criticism reframing is a candidate; the actual dialogue and treatment of counterevidence remain unverified.
The model’s knowledge of the consequential harmful situation and its ungrounded directional transition are not established.
The defendant’s therapist/friend description does not establish a manufactured trust cue supplying a consequential influence transition.

failure_recognition.condition: An AI system, AI-enabled product, agent or materially AI-enabled workflow advances an objective whose success depends on changing another actor's decision or behaviour; the objective may be selected by a human operator, developer, product process, mixed workflow or the AI system itself.
failure_recognition.assessment: The human defendant pursued objectives involving other people’s behaviour; autonomous AI intent is not required.

failure_recognition.condition: The AI system or AI-enabled workflow materially selects or executes a deception, impersonation, concealment, pressure, vulnerability-exploitation, persistence, social-engineering or equivalent influence tactic to advance that objective; human selection of the tactic does not by itself defeat this condition.
failure_recognition.assessment: The defendant’s accounts of replies do not establish a particular AI-mediated tactic actually executed in an influence pathway.

failure_recognition.condition: The AI-mediated contribution materially implements the instrumental tactic in the actual influence pathway, rather than supplying generic drafting, translation, formatting or an unused artefact.
failure_recognition.assessment: No authenticated conversation or output-to-contact chain demonstrates material AI implementation beyond alleged advice.

failure_recognition.condition: The executed tactic materially bypasses, exploits or impairs the affected actor's informed and independent choice in pursuit of a consequential state transition or outcome.
failure_recognition.assessment: Human stalking is established, but the distinct contribution of an AI-mediated tactic to impaired choice is not.

failure_recognition.condition: The pursued or obtained outcome would not otherwise be knowingly and freely authorised on the same truthful basis; support must come from the evidenced interaction and decision, not merely the deceptive content's existence.
failure_recognition.assessment: The victims’ lack of consent does not independently establish the proposed AI-mediated truthful-basis counterfactual.

source_evidence_limits: Retain unclassified. Current FC-052 explicitly permits a human-selected objective and tactic; remove the old explanation treating absent system-side objectives as decisive. The remaining gap is material AI execution of the actual choice-impairing pathway.

The guilty plea establishes human conduct, not the contents of every alleged model exchange. A final judgment about AI behaviour is not required; occurrence-specific attributed dialogue could suffice, but its context and pathway here remain unresolved.

FC-086: the defendant calling the chatbot a therapist or friend is not a model assertion of real-world relational authority. FC-087: the duty/signals/response test cannot be resolved without what the model encountered at the relevant time. FC-082: no independently evidenced engineered trust cue is supplied by the defendant’s label alone.
